about_the_game:
🏆 WIN TO EARN — High-Stakes Gameplay

One of the core features of X-WAR is the WIN TO EARN mode. Before each match, players from both teams place a stake using in-game currency, forming a shared prize pool. The winning team takes it all — the losers leave with nothing. Maximum tension, zero compromises.

👥 CLANS & COMPETITIONS
Team up with other players, form powerful alliances, and dominate in clan wars. Compete in tournaments with major rewards, climb the leaderboards, and enjoy fair play thanks to a robust anti-cheat system.

🔥 WEAPON & CHARACTER CUSTOMIZATION
Unlock over 25 weapon types and enhance them with 200+ modules — scopes, attachments, and other upgrades.
Customize your fighter’s appearance with unique gear and accessories to stand out on the battlefield.

💰 ECONOMY & PROGRESSION
Earn in-game currency by completing daily missions. Invest in better equipment, join clans, and participate in tournaments with massive prize pools.

🌃 REFERRAL SYSTEM
Invite friends using your personal promo code to earn tokens, gear, and exposure. The more people you bring in — the bigger your rewards!

content_descriptors.notes: Contains scenes of violence and images of blood.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (x64)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Ryzen with 4 physical cores
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 960 or AMD Radeon Rx 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (x64)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen with 6 physical cores
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6700
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 25 GB available space

short_description: X-WAR - is a team-based shooter with a unique token staking mechanic. Assemble your squad, place your bet before the match, and fight for the enemy’s pool. Winners take it all — losers walk away with nothing.
